topic:
THE POST-RH FRONTIER: EXTENDING ALPOGE-CLAUDE TO DEDEKIND ERH, GL_2 / BSD, AND A 100-PAGE HUMAN TEXTBOOK PROOF:
With RH and Q-GRH formally proved in Lean 4 and human reconstructions charting the route, this extended 8-specialist symposium stress-tests FOUR deep open research problems across all 13 primary/companion documents (`docs/rh_2026_deep/manifest.json`), enforced by a 3-phase dialectic protocol:

PHASE 1 (Turns 1-16) — VERBATIM PRIMARY-SOURCE BASELINE & PRECISION AUDIT:
Correct subtle conflations found in shorter runs by citing exact verbatim statements from the corpus:
- `rubinstein_2026_zeta_guide`: distinguish assumed `(H0)-(H12)` (`@ 810933`) from `Estimate C` proved in section III.2 (`@ 826576`), plus the worked lemniscate case & external census.
- `rubinstein_2026_lean_audit`, `naskrecki_2026_riemann_rev`, `adriazola_2026_dep_map`: verify `1,484,729` `nanoda` Lean kernel declarations, `175,187` modules, 5 theorems (`riemannHypothesis`, etc.), `{propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}`, `PC-1..PC-7`, and `R1-R5`.
- `siegel_brauer_2026` (Banks): note that Banks proves an EFFECTIVE constant `c(k) > 0` for fixed base field `k` via Masser's zero estimate on simple lattice vanishings `(1 - beta) log d_F >= c(k)`, leaving `k`-dependence across varying base fields rather than absolute uniformity across arbitrary `[k:Q]` — and contrast this with Alpoge's Lean formalization where Dedekind ERH remains unproved.
- `lamzouri_2013_grh`, `grenie_molteni_2022_classgroup`, `pair_corr_2026`: extract exact Corollary 1.1 (`n(q) <= (log q)^2`), Theorems 1.2/1.3/1.4 (`alpha(h)` and `P(a,q)`), Grenie-Molteni Theorems 1-4 (`(4 - 1/(2n)) log^2 Delta`, `(4 - 2/(3n)) log^2 Delta` on `Cl^2`, ~13% PARI/GP reduction as a constant-factor speedup inside sub-exponential `L_Delta(1/2)` Buchmann — NOT a polynomial break of imaginary-quadratic class-group VDFs!), and Kandhil-Languasco-Moree pair-correlation `n(q) << (log q)^(1+eps)` under Hypothesis 1.

PHASE 2 (Turns 17-34) — ADVERSARIAL BLACKBOARD DIALECTIC & EXTENSION/COMPRESSION DESIGN:
Actively use `@CLAIM`, `@CHALLENGE <cN>`, `@VOTE`, and `@RETRACT` on the Shared Blackboard across four open problems:
1) **Dedekind ERH over general number fields `K/Q`**: Where in Stages 1-10 is `Q` load-bearing (CM lemniscate lattice, Bost slope over `O_K`, Chowla-Selberg/Siegel mass covolumes, Behrend-choice Iwasawa tower, Vandiver weakening & `K`-groups of `O_K`), and how does Banks' `k`-dependent `c(k)` interact with discriminant scaling?
2) **Higher-Rank `GL_2` / Elliptic Curve `L(E,s)` & BSD**: Why does the sixfold cover of `GL_5` + unitary GGP Bessel/Fourier-Jacobi seesaw (`gan_ichino_2014_ggp`, `LinkDIV`) handle `GL_1` Dirichlet characters while resisting `GL_2` modular/elliptic `L`-functions (non-abelian Satake parameters, Ramanujan-Petersson, higher-rank theta lifts)?
3) **100-Page Human Textbook Compression Blueprint**: Map every dependency from `17.4M` Lean lines (`175,187` modules, `1,484,729` `nanoda` decls) to a self-contained textbook proof over `H0-H12`, section III.2, `PC-1..PC-7`, and `R1-R5`.
4) **Quantitative Post-GRH Algorithmic & Cryptographic Ledger**: Separate (i) newly unconditional deterministic/polylog bounds, (ii) constant-factor speedups inside sub-exponential `L_Delta(1/2)` (Buchmann/class-group VDFs, RSA/GNFS/ECDLP), (iii) still-conditional Dedekind ERH bounds, and (iv) vertical pair-correlation frontiers (`pair_corr_2026`).

PHASE 3 (Turns 35-42+) — RED-TEAM VERIFICATION & MONOGRAPH LOCK:
`RED_TEAM_CHAIR` and specialists adversarially audit every constant, theorem citation, and blackboard claim against primary docs before assembling and locking `rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph.md` (`>= 18000` bytes, 10 sections).

1) **PRIMARY-SOURCE GROUNDING FIRST**: Check `Ref docs inspected` in Session Status; use `@DOC_TOC <doc_id>` or `@DOC_SEARCH <doc_id|all> <keywords>`, then `@DOC_READ <doc_id> <offset>` to verify verbatim constants and theorems. Cite `[doc_id @ offset]` or exact theorem numbers for every claim. Avoid duplicating `(doc @ offset)` already listed in `Recent reads` unless cross-examining a discrepancy.
2) **BLACKBOARD DIALECTIC REQUIRED**: Across Phase 2 (turns 17-34), raise explicit `@CLAIM hypothesis:` / `@CLAIM proposal:` items for Dedekind ERH bottlenecks, GL_2 obstructions, textbook compression cuts, and crypto bounds, challenge weak claims with `@CHALLENGE cN: ...`, `@RETRACT` refuted items, and `@VOTE cN yes|no` once reconciled. Use `#proof_core`, `#extension_lab`, `#algo_crypto`, and `@WHISPER <name>: ...`. Pass turns across all 8 specialists (`NEXT: <name>`) without locking dyads. Only adjust `@SET_SAMPLING` when intentionally changing sampling regime.
3) **THREE WORKSPACE ARTIFACTS**:
- `@APPEND debate_notes: ...` for verified verbatim quotes, exact theorem inequalities, and red-team corrections.
- `@APPEND` / `@REPLACE frontier_ledger: ...` tracking every proof stage, extension barrier, compression target, and post-GRH theorem: `Domain / Component | Exact Mechanism or Theorem | Extension / Compression / Complexity Status | Primary Citation`.
- `@REPLACE rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph: ...` to lock ONE rigorous, citation-backed master monograph (`>= 18000` bytes, ZERO placeholders) containing all 10 required sections:
  `[Executive Overview & Post-RH Landscape]`, `[Primary-Source Audit: Lean Kernel TCB, H0-H12 & Estimate C Corrections]`, `[Worked Multiplicity Engine: Stepanov Over F_q vs Lemniscate & Iterated Theta Lifts]`, `[Automorphic Core: Gan-Ichino GGP Seesaw, LinkDIV & Sixfold GL_5 Cover]`, `[Dedekind ERH Over General Number Fields: Base-Field Barriers & Banks Effective Brauer-Siegel]`, `[Higher-Rank GL_2, Modular Forms, BSD & Why Grand RH Resists the Current Machinery]`, `[Spectral vs Functorial Divide: Connes Weil Form vs Alpoge-Claude Transport]`, `[100-Page Human Textbook Compression Blueprint (Stripping 17.4M Lean Lines)]`, `[Quantitative Post-GRH Algorithmic, Pair-Correlation & Cryptographic Ledger]`, and `[Red-Team Referee Report & Open 2027 Research Problems]`.
From turn 42 onward, vote `@END_RUN: <reason>` once `frontier_ledger.md`, blackboard claims, and `rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph.md` are verified (5 of 8 majority concludes cleanly). Always end with `NEXT: <name>`.
